summary: The registrant filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to furnish a press release announcing that its subsidiary, Robotic Assistance Devices, received an order for 12 additional RIO Mini autonomous security trailers from an existing construction client. No financial terms, per-share price, premium, or board recommendation were disclosed. The filing is a routine operational update on a product order, not a special situation. No risk-arb angle exists.
